verdict.rationale: Convex documents its own bulk data movement: `npx convex import` loads data from a file into a deployment, `npx convex export` dumps it to a ZIP, and Import & Export is listed as a database feature. That covers bulk ingestion and extraction across many documents. Transactional mutations and the scheduler are only building blocks a developer would use to write their own batch logic, so they earn no extra credit. Missing for 10: documented bulk update/delete or batch-mutation tooling, bulk operations exposed through the MCP server or HTTP API for agents, documented limits or behavior for large batches, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
